events.verdict: Richards (PHX) legally contests Vucevic's (CHI) turnaround jump shot attempt.
Phillips (CHI) swipes his hand at the ball and makes illegal contact with Durant's (PHX) wrist, which affects Durant's ability to secure the loose ball.
Richards (PHX) jumps vertically into the air and he absorbs the contact with White (CHI) in the air prior to the release of White's pass.
Richards (PHX) firms up in Buzelis' (CHI) path and marginal contact occurs as the two players come together during the pick.
Giddey (CHI) legally contests Booker's (PHX) jump shot attempt. Replay review confirms Booker is behind the three-point line before going into the air during his jump shot attempt.
Booker (PHX) is moving to his left and not in a legal guarding position when body contact occurs with Giddey (CHI), which affects his driving shot attempt.
Buzelis (CHI) legally contests Booker's (PHX) jump shot attempt.
Richards (PHX) momentarily grasps and releases Vucevic's (CHI) jersey and the contact during the rebounding opportunity is marginal.
Beal (PHX) brings his right arm towards the ball and marginal brush contact occurs with White (CHI) during his driving shot attempt in the paint.
Durant's (PHX) off-arm comes forward towards Buzelis (CHI) while Durant is in possession of the ball and the contact with Buzelis' front is marginal.
Giddey (CHI) legally contests Beal's (PHX) jump shot attempt.
Vucevic (CHI) firms up over his left leg in Allen's (PHX) path and marginal contact occurs as Allen moves into the pick.

O'Neale (PHX) comes alongside Giddey's (CHI) path to the basket and he absorbs the marginal contact. Additionally, as O'Neale brings his arm down, he lightly brushes the top of Giddey's head during his driving floater attempt. Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.
Allen (PHX) legally contests Buzelis' (CHI) jump shot attempt.
Allen (PHX) reaches in for the ball and makes contact with Buzelis' (CHI) left arm, which affects his control of the ball during his upward shooting motion.
